# Vendored web dependencies

Generated by `scripts/vendor_web.py` - do not edit by hand. Versions, tarball integrity
hashes, per-file sha256 and the two small local patches are recorded in
`VENDOR.lock.json`. Licenses: `three/LICENSE` (MIT), `spark/LICENSE` (MIT),
`webxr-input-profiles/LICENSE.md` (MIT).

Re-run `python scripts/vendor_web.py` after changing a version in the script;
`python scripts/vendor_web.py --check` verifies the files against the lock offline.
